★ The rectangle is NOT predicted directly by any network.
It is decoded from dense per-pixel maps (Q, cos2θ, sin2θ, W) + P, as in GR-ConvNet / LGD.
TRAINING DATA & LOSSES — two independent runs
one row = (image, object, part) · official object-ID splits
splits: train Seen / test Seen / test Unseen (overlap images removed)
square images resized to 224 (bilinear); masks resized nearest
grasp label = rotated rect (x, y, w, h, θ) in pixels
1 sample per image · no text input
target = grasps of all parts in the image
AdamW · lr 1e-3 · 15 ep · bs 32 · bf16 AMP
frozen: CLIP image + text encoders (eval mode)
AdamW · lr 1e-4 · 10 ep · bs 32 · bf16 AMP
R1 and R2 are trained separately (no joint fine-tuning). No gradient flows through composition or decoding; α, T, λ are tuned on val afterwards.
